channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in South Africa
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Dried Fruit SA "Goodness Goes Together" competition: win 3 pairs of PUMA shoes – Dried Fruit South Africa (Dried Fruit SA)
item.description: Prize: One winner receives three pairs of PUMA shoes (for moving, everyday lifestyle and relaxing; styles/sizes chosen within a price range, subject to availability). Deadline: December 19, 2026. Complete and submit the competition form on driedfruitsouthafrica.co.za. No purchase necessary. South African residents 18+ with a valid SA delivery address. Opens 19 October 2026, closes 00:00 SAST on 20 December 2026; random draw 21 December 2026 (winner contacted by Instagram DM/email)

item.title: LIFT 12 Days of Christmas 2026 – LIFT (Global Aviation Operations)
item.description: Prize: 12 getaways for two (one per day, 1–12 December): return LIFT flights, Europcar car hire and a stay with an accommodation partner (e.g. AfriCamps); every day you play also unlocks LIFT Wallet funds, up to R500 in total. Deadline: December 12, 2026. Create a free LIFT Profile, then sign up on the 12 Days of Christmas form with the same name and email. From 1 to 12 December LIFT emails a link each morning; open the day’s door and enter for that day’s getaway. Wallet funds must be used on flights booked before 15 January 2027. Competition T&Cs on lift.co.za apply.

item.title: Kraken: A Christmas Call with Poldi – win a video call with Lukas Podolski – Kraken (Payward Ltd.)
item.description: Prize: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

item.title: Penguin Random House SA: win 1 of 2 Lottie Brooks Christmas hampers – Penguin Random House South Africa
item.description: Prize: Two winners each get Lottie Brooks’s Twelve Disasters of Christmas (signed bookplate), a KitKat Chunky, an iron-on patch and a badge. Deadline: December 6, 2026. Complete the entry form on the competition page. Free, no purchase, one entry per person. 18+, South African residents. Closes 23:59 SAST on 6 December 2026

item.title: Win with FALKEN – Bike Giveaway: BULLS e-trail or carbon gravel bikes – SOKRATIV GmbH (with Dunlop Tyre Europe / BULLS / ZEG)
item.description: Prize: 1× BULLS Copperhead EVO AM 2 e-trail bike (RRP €4,999) and 3× BULLS Machete RX 1 carbon gravel bikes (RRP €1,999 each). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the free participation form on win-with-falken.com, select a bike and confirm terms. No purchase of FALKEN tyres required. One entry per person. Open to residents 18+ in Belgium, Bulgaria, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Czech Republic or Hungary. Closes Nov 30, 2026 at 18:00

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: Getaway: Win an overnight stay for two at The Marine, Hermanus – Getaway Magazine
item.description: Prize: One night for two in a Luxury Double Room with sea view incl. breakfast at The Marine, worth R15,000. Deadline: November 16, 2026. Fill in the free online form on getaway.co.za (name, email, phone, answer a question). Delivery within South Africa only. Closes 16 November 2026. Prize redeemable 1 October 2026 - 31 August 2027, excl. peak season

item.title: Woolworths MyDifference Play & Win (Black Friday edition) – Woolworths
item.description: Prize: Woolworths vouchers, cashback up to R50,000 (VIP up to R100,000) and product prizes such as air fryers, Nespresso machines or iPads. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Join MyDifference for free in the Woolworths app and play the weekly Play & Win game in the loyalty tab (once a week; link arrives by email each Monday). No purchase stated. Games run 2 November (00:01) to 27 November 2026 (23:59). Residency not stated (Woolworths South Africa)

item.title: ABC: Win a Meerkat 50 wood chipper – Africa Biomass Company (ABC)
item.description: Prize: A Meerkat 50 chipper worth R17,825 (VAT incl.). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter on the giveaway page on abc.co.za; free, extra entry points for optional steps such as newsletter or social follow (none are mandatory). South African residents 18+. Closes 23:59 on 30 November 2026

item.title: AVBOB 10th Annual Poetry Competition – AVBOB
item.description: Prize: Cash prizes for winning poems (amounts not stated on the pages read). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Register a free profile on avbobpoetry.co.za and submit poems online (up to ten, 11 written languages). Open to South African citizens; skill-based. Closes 23:59 SAST on 30 November 2026

item.title: Glowming: Win three nights in Cape Town for two – Glowming
item.description: Prize: 3 nights for two in a Cape Town apartment (The RandA Collection), a travel voucher and high tea for two at the Mount Nelson. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entries by joining the free Glowming Journey (2 entries) and a daily check-in on the Journey diary; buying pouches gives extra entries but is not required. Optional social posts also earn entries. South African residents 18+. Closes 23:59 on 30 November 2026

item.title: Jacaranda FM x Miway Friday Is MiDay: Win R1,000 cash – Miway / Jacaranda FM
item.description: Prize: R1,000 cash each Friday (R2,000 if you are a Miway policyholder). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Send a voice note on why Friday is your day to the WhatsApp number in the T&Cs (+27 84 850 0942); winners are chosen on Breakfast with Martin Bester. South African residents 18+. No policy needed for the R1,000. Runs 4 September to 30 November 2026

item.title: Penguin Random House SA: Win Jan Braai / Idees vol vrees plus Braai Broekies gear – Penguin Random House South Africa
item.description: Prize: A copy of Jan Braai / Idees vol vrees by Kobus Galloway plus a Braai Broekies product of your choice worth R1,000. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the free online entry form. South African residents 18+; no purchase needed; one entry per person. Closes 23:59 SAST on 30 November 2026

item.title: Clicks Have Your Say: Win R500 ClubCard cashback – Clicks (ClubCard magazine)
item.description: Prize: R500 cashback on your Clicks ClubCard. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Email your thoughts about Clicks to clubcardletters@tppsa.co.za. Open to South African residents 18+ who are Clicks ClubCard members (free sign-up). Closes 1 December 2026

item.title: Clicks: Win a Beauty Box hamper (2 winners) – Clicks (ClubCard magazine)
item.description: Prize: Beauty box hamper worth R4,000 each (2 winners). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Clicks ClubCard magazine competition. Free online form (Woobox) linked from the Clicks site. Open to South African residents 18+ who are Clicks ClubCard members (ClubCard sign-up is free, no purchase required per the rules). Closes 1 December 2026

item.title: Clicks: Win a D'Licious hamper (3 winners) – Clicks (ClubCard magazine)
item.description: Prize: D'Licious hamper worth R1,000 each (3 winners). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Clicks ClubCard magazine competition. Free online form (Woobox) linked from the Clicks site. Open to South African residents 18+ who are Clicks ClubCard members (ClubCard sign-up is free, no purchase required per the rules). Closes 1 December 2026

item.title: Clicks: Win a DKNY Ice Pop fragrance (3 winners) – Clicks (ClubCard magazine)
item.description: Prize: DKNY Ice Pop fragrance worth R999 each (3 winners). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Clicks ClubCard magazine competition. Free online form (Woobox) linked from the Clicks site. Open to South African residents 18+ who are Clicks ClubCard members (ClubCard sign-up is free, no purchase required per the rules). Closes 1 December 2026

item.title: Château Gâteaux 365 Birthday Campaign: a free cake every day – Château Gâteaux
item.description: Prize: 365 gourmet cakes, one daily winner (non-winners get a R100 voucher on a large cake). Deadline: December 31, 2026. Download the Château Gâteaux app and fully complete your registration (name, email, date of birth, phone) for automatic entry; no purchase needed. South African residents 18+. Runs 1 January - 31 December 2026

item.title: DocTalk: Win a 2026 Suzuki S-Presso – DocTalk
item.description: Prize: A brand-new 2026 Suzuki S-Presso car. Deadline: January 15, 2027. Download the free DocTalk ZA app, register and complete your profile for automatic entry (no purchase). South African citizens or permanent residents 18+ with valid ID. Closes 23:59 SAST on 15 January 2027

item.title: Algoa FM (Eastern Cape only): Care Like a Champion - win R3,000 in Pick n Pay vouchers – Algoa FM / Pick n Pay
item.description: Prize: R1,500 in Pick n Pay digital grocery vouchers for you plus R1,500 for the person or cause you nominate (weekly). Deadline: February 25, 2027. WhatsApp or Telegram the keyword CHAMPION plus your full name, town and a nomination (person, charity or community group, with their contact details and a short reason) to 061 794 0940 (data rates apply); a listener is called live each Thursday on the afternoon Drive show. Only for people living in the Algoa FM broadcast area (Eastern Cape), 18+, no Algoa FM win in the last 90 days. Runs 17 September 2026 to 25 February 2027

item.title: 947 x Spur: Win up to R2,000 in Spur vouchers – Primedia / Spur
item.description: Prize: R1,000 Spur voucher (R2,000 if you have the Spur app). Deadline: June 26, 2027. WhatsApp the word SPUR to 066 050 6830 and answer the birthday question (max 3 entries per day); winners are called on Saturdays on 947. South African citizens or permanent residents 18+. Runs 24 October 2026 to 26 June 2027

item.title: Penguin Random House SA: Win a Greenie hamper and Do Not Feed the Monkey – Penguin Random House South Africa
item.description: Prize: 1 of 5 Greenie hampers (reusable food covers, R460 each) plus a copy of Do Not Feed the Monkey. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the free entry form on the Penguin Random House South Africa website. South African residents 18+. Newsletter sign-ups are optional. Closes 23:59 SAST on 30 November 2026

item.title: Penguin Random House SA: Win a Camp Half-Blood hamper – Penguin Random House South Africa
item.description: Prize: 1 of 2 Camp Half-Blood hampers (The Wild Zone book, tote bag, cap, magnets, patch, T-shirt, Book Cozi and blanket). Deadline: December 4, 2026. Fill in the free entry form on the Penguin Random House South Africa website (name, email, province). South African residents 18+, one entry per person. Newsletter sign-up is optional. Closes 23:59 SAST on 4 December 2026

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
